Cadence in the cord

Description: With the Brine Signet shattered, every house hunts whatever might make its story law. Lady Seralyne — the Velvet Spider of Suncourt — sells what she claims is the dragon’s true note: not the lost thing itself, only a counterfeit cadence arranged to be believed, and a wavering house is ready to buy it as proof its claim rings true. We cut one of her sendings from the wire first. Read the pleasant words; then attend to the silences between them, and expose the forgery she is truly selling.
